question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ticket gives ______ travel on city buses for as little as Rs. 100.
solution:
The correct answer is "**unlimited**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Unlimited** means **without any control** or limit.

 
 
• **Example:** *Steve upgraded his wifi to the **unlimited** plan. *
